notes: RunPod exited the pod twice during evaluation on the EUR-IS-3 machine family.
The first full run completed 600s of training and wrote final_model.int6.ptz before the pod was terminated during stride-16 sliding-window evaluation.
Because torchrun resolved to the system interpreter instead of the venv interpreter, zstandard was not available in-process and the export used zlib, pushing total bytes over the 16,000,000 cap.
